# Vendored OMO LSP MCP bridge (`@code-yeongyu/lsp-daemon@0.1.0`)

This directory vendors the bundled **LSP MCP bridge** that the previous
`oh-my-openagent@4.19.4` (OMO) plugin registered as `mcp.lsp`. AI-EngKit keeps
it as an AI-EngKit-owned, absolute-path MCP server so the restored `lsp` MCP
never depends on a cache-relative path such as
`node ../../lsp-daemon/dist/cli.js mcp`.

## Why vendored (not installed from a registry)

The upstream package is **not published to npm**. Verified 2026-09-14:

```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' \
  'https://registry.npmjs.org/@code-yeongyu%2Flsp-daemon'   # 404
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' \
  'https://registry.npmjs.org/@code-yeongyu%2Flsp-tools-mcp' # 404
```

The package exists only inside the OMO plugin cache as a prebuilt Bun bundle.
Vendoring that bundle under a deliberate layout is the only non-speculative
source; no registry URL is invented.

## Layout

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `dist/cli.js` | Self-contained Bun-built ESM bundle (`--target node`). Imports only `node:*` builtins — no `node_modules` required. |
| `dist/package.json` | Read by `dist/cli.js` (`resolveDaemonVersion`) to resolve the daemon version directory (`~/.omo/lsp-daemon/v0.1.0`). Must stay next to `cli.js`. |

The image installs this directory at the stable absolute path
`/opt/ai-engkit/vendor/lsp-daemon`, and `entrypoint.d/02-init-config.sh`
generates:

```json
"lsp": {
  "type": "local",
  "command": ["node", "/opt/ai-engkit/vendor/lsp-daemon/dist/cli.js", "mcp"],
  "enabled": true
}
```

`mcp.lsp` is a **separate** entry from the native OpenCode `lsp` block, which
continues to be generated by the Admin LSP management path.

## Exposed MCP tools

`status`, `diagnostics`, `goto_definition`, `find_references`, `symbols`,
`prepare_rename`, `rename`, `install_decision`.

## Refreshing the bundle

Only refresh from a verified upstream source — never from an unverified URL or
a cache path baked into runtime config:

1. Obtain the package (e.g. from a newer OMO plugin cache or an upstream
   source that publishes it).
2. Copy `dist/cli.js` and `dist/package.json` here.
3. Recompute and update the SHA-256 values above.
4. Update the version references in this README and, if the protocol changed,
   `entrypoint.d/02-init-config.sh`.
5. Run `test/test-lsp-mcp-config.sh` (config assertions + `tools/list` smoke).

## Smoke test

```bash
{
  printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"smoke","version":"1.0"}}}'
  printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"}'
  sleep 1
  printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}'
  sleep 2
} | node vendor/omo-lsp-daemon/dist/cli.js mcp
```

## Runtime state

The bridge spawns a shared per-user daemon over a unix socket. State lives under
`~/.omo/lsp-daemon/v<version>/` (the `omo-config` volume in Compose), which the
upstream bundle already used.
